question: Expenditure incurred by residents during their foreign tour will be added to which component while calculating national income?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Private final consumption expenditure**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Private final consumption expenditure (PFCE) refers to the expenditure incurred by households on goods and services for their own use.
 
• PFCE includes all private consumption of both durable and non-durable goods.
 
• Expenditure incurred by residents during their foreign tours is considered a part of PFCE as it is an expenditure on goods and services consumed by the residents.
 
• This component is a major part of the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and is used to measure the standard of living of a country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Government final consumption expenditure (GFCE)**

 
 
• GFCE is the expenditure incurred by the government on goods and services that are provided to the public.
 
• It includes spending on public services such as defense, education, healthcare, and infrastructure development.
 
• GFCE is an important part of the national accounts and contributes to the calculation of GDP.
 
 
 
• **Gross foreign capital formation**
 
 
• It refers to the addition to the fixed assets of the economy during a period of time.
 
• This includes investments in machinery, equipment, and infrastructure from foreign sources.
 
• It is a measure of foreign direct investment (FDI) in the country.
 
 
 
• **Gross domestic capital formation**
 
 
• Gross domestic capital formation includes investments in fixed assets within the country.
 
• It is a measure of the total value of the increase in fixed assets within the country during a particular period.
 
• It is an important indicator of the level of economic development in a country.
